summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks about King Marutta’s wealth and power; Vyasa recounts Marutta’s lineage and Indra persuading Vrihaspati not to officiate the king’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Marutta conducts a grand sacrifice on a golden hill near Mount Meru, surrounded by countless shining golden vessels and princes.
Indra mounted on his celestial horse addresses the sage Vrihaspati amid assembled gods, urging him not to serve the mortal king Marutta.
The ascetic Samvarta abandons wealth and wanders into the forest with nothing but the open sky covering his body.
